CONTEXT FROM PRIOR EXPLORATION:

Current state:
- /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/src/app/pricing/page.tsx (102 lines) renders: PricingSection (from home), CustomPlanCta, RoiCalculator
- /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/src/components/home/pricing-section.tsx (277 lines) — shared with homepage, has 3 plans + comparison table + Monthly/Quarterly/Annual toggle
- /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/src/components/pricing/roi-calculator.tsx (537 lines) + .module.css (762 lines)
- /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/src/components/pricing/custom-plan-cta.tsx (56 lines) + .module.css (193 lines)
- Plan prices duplicated in /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/src/lib/constants/pricing.ts AND inside roi-calculator.tsx

Confirmed diffs vs live (Webflow pricing.html):
1. quarterlyPrice wrong: src has 899/1799/3149 — Webflow has 719/1349/2249 (lines 34/66/98 of pricing.ts)
2. CTA label dynamic ("Choose Plan" / "Get Started") — Webflow uses "Choose Plan" everywhere (pricing-section.tsx lines 42-46)
3. No "when paid quarterly/annually" clarification text under price
4. Pricing page is missing a dedicated hero — currently jumps straight into PricingSection. Webflow has a dedicated hero (.new-price-sec.pricing-page-newsc) with h1 "Pick a Flexible Subscription. Get Predictable Output." + subtext "Scale your output with a ready-to-go execution team — no onboarding delays, no overhead."
5. Hardcoded duplicate data: PLAN_PRICES, PRESETS, FIELD_TOOLTIPS in roi-calculator.tsx need to live in lib/constants/pricing.ts
6. CTA hrefs may not match Webflow:
   - Starter: https://portal.boldteq.com/services/starter-mwma05bdxjhzji0zwzav/checkout?variation=9
   - Growth: https://portal.boldteq.com/services/growth-0kjv8vdq1slacrk0eujt/checkout?variation=11
   - Pro: https://portal.boldteq.com/services/pro-c8jtfwr3tdjelxvygqrz/checkout?variation=38
7. Plan name pill styling — currently may not match Webflow exact: gradient bg #21cfff→#019ae6, padding 5px 8px, font-size 14px, weight 500

Webflow ground-truth values pulled:
- .pricing-grid.new: grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap 16px; padding 5px each side
- .pricing-card-2: padding 10px 10px 15px; bg #effafe; border 1px solid #21cfff36; border-radius 8px

- .button-pricing: padding 10px 24px; bg #082753; border-radius 10px; font-size 16px weight 700; hover gradient #21cfff→#019ae6
- .h3-heading-3 (price): font-size 25px; weight 700; color #082753
- .pricing-badge (Save 10%/20%): padding 2px 8px; bg #27d3661a; color #18c958; border-radius 5px; font-size 12px
- .pricing-table-cell: padding 24px 12px; border-bottom 1px solid #21cfff36; color #5b616e

- Stack: Next 16, React 19, TypeScript strict, NO `any`. Tailwind 4 + CSS Modules with exact Webflow values.
- Project rule: read Webflow CSS file, extract exact values, no Tailwind defaults for layout/spacing
- Pricing page reuses PricingSection from homepage per CLAUDE.md
- Must work at responsive breakpoints: 479, 767, 991, 1280, 1440

DELIVERABLE — produce a detailed implementation plan with:
1. List of files to modify (exact paths) with what changes in each
2. List of new files to create (exact paths)
3. Component composition order on /pricing page
4. Constants file shape (single source of truth for plans + ROI presets)
5. CSS Module strategy — which sections need new .module.css files
6. Validation steps (pnpm build, Playwright screenshot, manual checks)
7. Risk areas — what could go wrong and how to verify

Be specific with file paths and CSS values. Under 700 words.
